environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an ALB with public-facing target group. FLASK_DEBUG=1 is set in the ECS task definition. The APP_SIGNING_KEY environment variable is set to a static value shared across all service instances via AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store (plaintext, not SecureString). The ALB security group allows inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. No origin access restrictions are configured - clients connect directly to the ALB endpoint.
